# Checkpoint

## Issue
The Drive share member view is mixing member and invitation data across shares. Stores need to isolate data by "'`shareId`, and a utility must combine existing email addresses from members and both invitation types.

- Inspect the invitation/member stores, view and action call sites, types, and nearby tests.
- Change store APIs/state to key records by share ID while preserving independent internal/external invitations.
- Add `getExistingEmails` in the appropriate share utility module and cover behavior using existing test conventions.
- Run relevant existing tests and report results.

## Constraints
Use repository code and existing tests only. Do not change git history, index baseline, or harness configuration.

I’m checking all callers now because several store actions also use these stores, so the share keyed API needs to preserve their behavior while isolating each share.

        return 'inactive';
    }
    return 'shared';

item.text:
Updated the Zustand member and invitation stores to key data by `shareId`, with separate per-share handling for internal and external invitations. The new member view now reads and updates only the active share. Added `getExistingEmails` and used it in both member views.

**Verification:** Type check passed; targeted lint reported no errors (four existing hook dependency warnings); the existing `_shares` suite passed (7 suites, 28 tests); `git diff --check` passed. The repository has no dedicated tests for these Zustand stores.

Changed files: [invitation store](/app/packages/drive-store/zustand/share/invitations.store.ts), [member store](/app/packages/drive-store/zustand/share/members.store.ts), [Zustand member view](/app/packages/drive-store/store/_views/useShareMemberViewZustand.tsx), [email utility](/app/packages/drive-store/utils/share.ts).
